messages:
alex: FYI - escalated ticket from ACME: audit-log export job export-97 consistently 403s when downloading re-encryption bundle. Customer seeing missing events from 2026-02-28 onwards in their SIEM. They need a backfill plan and root cause.
alex: brief details: tenant=acme-co, job=export-97, s3 bucket=redwood-audit-exports-prod, manifest path=/exports/2026-02-28/export-97.manifest, customer says some objects are zero-byte or 403.
jin: can you paste the exact error and any export-service logs you have? also need the role arn used for the export and whether we've rotated any KMS aliases recently.
alex: log snippet:
```
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z ERROR export/handler.go:172 download failed status=403 msg="AccessDenied: Access Denied"
requestId=b2f7c1 job=export-97 tenant=acme-co range=2026-02-28/2026-03-01
2026-02-28T14:12:04Z ERROR export/kms.go:58 Encrypt failed: kms:InvalidCiphertextException
```
alex: role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-export-service ; customer tried to GET manifest and got 403 in their SIEM connector logs.
casey: quick checks: 1) S3 object ACLs and bucket policy (we use bucket-owner-full-control via put-object) 2) KMS key policy + whether alias was deleted/rotated 3) export service's STS identity - run aws sts get-caller-identity from runner to confirm principal
casey: also check if we recently enabled strict kms:GrantIsForAWSResource enforcement on the key (that breaks older grants)
alex: ran the sts call from an export pod:
```
$ aws sts get-caller-identity
{
  "UserId": "AROAXXXXX:export-runner",
  "Account": "123456789012",
  "Arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-export-service/export-runner"
}
```
alex: checked bucket ACLs: objects present, some are 0 bytes. sample object: s3://redwood-audit-exports-prod/exports/2026-02-28/part-0003.gz size=0
jin: 0-byte objects + KMS error -> likely export failed mid-write, then manifest still listed the key. But kms:InvalidCiphertextException suggests decrypt attempted on wrong ciphertext (maybe key rotated, envelope mismatch)
jin: can you paste the KMS key id/alias used in the export job metadata? we need the CMK ARN from the export metadata
alex: export metadata excerpt:
```
"encryption": {"kms_key_alias": "alias/redwood-audit-2024-rotate", "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"}
```
casey: that alias was rotated last year but we kept a rotation mapping. did we run the alias reconciliation in the rotation-tool v2? search logs for rotation-tool runs around 2026-02-27
casey: immediate triage steps I suggest:
- confirm key policy allows redwood-export-service principal kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey
- check CloudTrail for KMS:GenerateDataKey/Decrypt failures with requestId
- run a replay of export-97 for the affected time range into a staging bucket (replay job) instead of touching prod manifests
- generate presigned urls for the customer for manifest and staging backfill while we investigate
alex: I checked key policy: it includes the service principal but the policy has a condition that restricts usage to aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn. export runner uses assumed-role arn which should satisfy SourceArn but maybe the condition references older role name.
jin: that's likely. policy conditions often break after role renames/assume-role changes. please paste the key policy snippet (redact ARNs as needed).
alex: key policy snippet:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodExports",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-export-service"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012", "aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-export-service"}}
}
```
alex: note: our export pods assume role with session name export-runner, so SourceArn in requests is arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-export-service/export-runner which no longer equals the role arn in the condition -> KMS reject.
jin: yep that's the root cause, policy condition mismatch. quick fix: relax the SourceArn condition to allow assumed-role ARNs or remove SourceArn and rely on SourceAccount + principal. I can open a fast ticket to patch the policy.
anna: customer priority is high; they need ETA for backfill. can we stage a replay within next 4 hours?
casey: we can. playbook for staging replay (short):
1) copy manifest and objects list to staging bucket (redwood-audit-staging)
2) run export-replay --job export-97 --start 2026-02-28 --end 2026-03-01 --target-bucket redwood-audit-staging --use-existing-objects
3) run integrity check: sha256 of each part vs manifest
4) generate presigned urls and share with customer
casey: commands (ops-runner):
```
$ export-replay --job export-97 --range 2026-02-28:2026-03-01 --target s3://redwood-audit-staging/exports/replay-97
$ aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit-staging/exports/replay-97/ --recursive
```
casey: while replay runs, jin patch key policy. after policy change, re-run replay to ensure encryption uses active key and objects not zero-byte.
jin: I'll prepare the policy patch, target rollback window 30m. Patch will change Condition to match sts assumed-role ARNs using StringLike with prefix arn:aws:sts::*:assumed-role/redwood-export-service/* or remove SourceArn
jin: security note: any change to KMS policies must be reviewed — I'll add a brief approval in the change ticket and limit to the single key ARN.
security-bot: [alert] KMS policy change requested: key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789 - ticket #SEC-1423 - link: https://redwood/ops/tickets/SEC-1423
alex: I'm going to run the staging replay now and will post progress. creating presigned urls for existing staging parts that are valid while replay runs.
alex: presigned url command for customer (example):
```
$ aws s3 presign s3://redwood-audit-staging/exports/replay-97/part-0001.gz --expires-in 3600
https://s3.amazonaws.com/...
```
anna: please ping me when first batch ready so I can share with the customer. they want an ETA for full window backfill.
casey: estimate: replay for one day of audit data is ~30m per 100GB with current cluster; job range 2026-02-28 -> 2026-03-01 is 24h window -> estimate 45-60m including integrity pass. will confirm after first run.
support-bot: ACTIONS: 1) jin -> patch KMS key policy (SEC-1423) 2) casey -> start replay to staging and run integrity (OPS-2987) 3) alex -> generate presigned urls and notify customer 4) anna -> coordinate customer comms/ETA. Assigned and tagged. Will update ticket in 1 hour.
jin: patch applied to key policy (rolled forward). watch for CloudTrail Decrypt success events. If we see no failures by +10m, proceed to re-run export to prod or finish staging replay.
alex: replay job started, initial progress: copied 12/78 parts, integrity checks running on completed parts. presigned urls shared for 3 parts to customer.
anna: customer confirmed they could pull the shared parts, SIEM connector accepted them. thanks. keep me posted on full completion.
casey: replay finished successfully. integrity check OK. job runtime 52m. moving replay objects to prod export path after signing off with security.
jin: CloudTrail shows KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey success for export-runner after policy patch. no further InvalidCiphertext exceptions.
support-bot: UPDATE: ticket escalated -> resolved pending postmortem. Postmortem owner: jin. Timeline and remediation to be posted in incidents channel. Closing slack thread for now :white_check_mark:
